sources.snippet: Overview fuse-1 Lite is a novel fusion model that combines the speed and efficiency of a small language model (LFM2.5-2.6B, 2.70B params) with the coding expertise of a large MoE model (Qwen3.6-35B-A3B). Rather than distilling knowledge or fine-tuning from scratch, fuse-1 Lite transplants actual expert weights from the donor model and trains a lightweight router to selectively activate them ...

sources.snippet: Vasko Djack, an individual developer active on Hugging Face as "Akahsizrr." The "fuse-1 Lite" he released adopts a third approach that is neither distillation nor merging: it "transplants" only the coding-specialized experts from the 35B parameter MoE model Qwen3.6-35B-A3B into the lightweight model LFM2.5-2.6B.
